sources.entry: TickTick - Simple and effective to-do list and task manager that helps you organize all aspects of life. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/id966085870?platform=mac)

summary.name: TickTick
summary.one_liner: TickTick is a to-do list and task manager that also includes calendar views, a Pomodoro timer, and a habit tracker.
use_cases: organize work projects and personal tasks
plan daily, weekly, or monthly schedule
share task lists and assign tasks with colleagues
track countdowns to birthdays, exams, and deadlines
summary.what_it_does: TickTick organizes to-do lists, tasks, and schedules with yearly, monthly, weekly, daily, agenda, and multi-day calendar views, plus Kanban, timeline, and Eisenhower Matrix layouts. It includes a Pomodoro timer using 25-minute intervals and a habit tracker with statistics. Tasks can be created by voice, with AI extracting dates and priorities, and natural-language date recognition sets reminders as you type. Lists can be shared and tasks assigned, and the app syncs across phone, computer, tablet, and watch. The page also mentions MCP, CLI, and OpenClaw connections for automation.
notable: Constant Reminder keeps notifying until the task is completed
Voice capture with AI extraction of dates, priorities and multiple tasks
Pomodoro timer and habit tracker built in
Listed on awesome-mac as freeware with a Mac App Store link
caveats: Premium tier exists; education discount of 25% is offered to eligible teachers and students
Some features such as the full set may require Premium; the page does not specify which features are paid
